name: husky
about: A Siberian husky: about 55 cm at the withers, gray and white, a white face with a dark mask, ears up, a thick tail.
sources: A Siberian husky male is 51 to 61 cm tall at the withers, a female 48 to 58 cm; often gray and white, with white paws and legs, facial markings and a white tail tip (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siberian_Husky).
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
